name: Protein Cinnamon Roll French Toast Bake
description: Gooey cinnamon-swirl French toast casserole with Sola and Nature's Own protein breads, cottage cheese, and Orgain vanilla protein; no icing.
ingredients: 65 g Nature's Own Protein Plus bread
226 g Great Value 2% small curd cottage cheese
113 g Great Value nonfat plain Greek yogurt
38.25 g Orgain Organic Protein 50 Superfoods vanilla bean powder
instructions: Cut both breads into cubes and spread in a greased 9-by-9-inch baking dish.
Blend cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, egg whites, whole eggs, 180 g milk, Orgain protein powder, 3 g cinnamon, 10 g vanilla extract, and salt until smooth.
Pour custard over bread, press gently, and refrigerate 30–60 minutes or overnight.
Mix Swerve brown sugar, melted light butter, remaining 30 g milk, 10 g cinnamon, and 5 g vanilla extract. Dollop over bread and gently swirl.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 15–25 minutes more, until the center reaches 160°F (71°C).
Rest 10 minutes and divide into six portions. No icing.
